snippet.title: Object Wars - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Object Wars on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1936800 !
Check our website : https://links.object-wars.com

Dive into a world where chaos is king, objects face each other in relentless battles for their survival. 
Master the Air Pulse and defy gravity to reach unexpected locations to surprise your enemies. 
Use devastating weapons made from everyday objects and obliterate your opponents.
Master the art of jumping, aiming and shooting to triumph over your enemies and become the ruler of this quirky world !
Prepare yourself for intense and hilarious battles in a universe gone mad where everything can come to life !

Music by @Odyzon
